All Your Fleets: Shows the fleets at the planet you're currently viewing, grouped by owner, plus any fleets you've Watched.
你的全部舰队: 显示你当前查看的星球上的舰队（按归属分组），以及你监视的舰队。

All Your Fleets: This tab is for management of your fleets, so left-clicking a fleet opens the fleet management window.  If you want to select a fleet from this screen, you can, but you'll need to right-click it.
你的全部舰队: 这个页签用于管理你的舰队：左键点击舰队会打开舰队管理窗口。如果你只是想在这里选中某支舰队，也可以，但要右键点击它。

All Your Fleets: Choose a buildable structure and click in the planet gravwell to build.
你的全部舰队: 选择一个可建造的建筑，然后在星球引力井内点击即可建造。

All Your Fleets: Spend Science here to unlock higher-level units and structures; more techs appear as you capture fleets with ships that can benefit from them.
你的全部舰队: 在这里花费科技点，解锁更高等级的单位与建筑；随着你缴获含有受益舰船的舰队，会出现更多科技。

All Your Fleets: Hacking is done with flagships at the same planet unless otherwise specified. Many structures and planets have potential hacks.
你的全部舰队: 除非另有说明，入侵由同一星球上的旗舰执行。许多建筑与星球都有可入侵的项目。

All Your Fleets: Helps you plan your strategy; this lists your active objectives. Left-click on an Objective to focus on it, or right-click to cycle its priority between lower, normal, and higher.
你的全部舰队: 帮你规划战略：这里列出你当前的目标。左键点击目标可聚焦它，右键点击可在较低、普通、较高之间循环切换优先级。

All Your Fleets: Story entries for your current campaign, newest first; left-click one to read it in full, or right-click to dismiss it as read without opening it.
你的全部舰队: 当前战役的剧情条目，最新的在最前；左键点击可完整阅读，右键点击可标记为已读而不打开。

All Your Fleets: Gameplay and strategy tips you've unlocked, newest first; left-click one to read it in full, or right-click to dismiss it as read without opening it.
你的全部舰队: 你已解锁的玩法与策略提示，最新的在最前；左键点击可完整阅读，右键点击可标记为已读而不打开。

All Your Fleets: Outguard are anti-AI mercenary groups you can call in once you've hacked the beacon they answer to; they don't cost energy and summon faster than regular ships, but act on their own once deployed.
你的全部舰队: 外卫是反 AI 的雇佣兵团；入侵它们所回应的信标后即可呼叫。它们不消耗能量，召唤速度也快于常规舰船，但部署后会自行行动。
